The balance and ideas in this game were revolutionary at the time.

The X-COM series (X-COM UFO Defense & Terror From the Deep)This game requires a lot of strategy and is prone to rage quit along with a bunch of "That is just Bullshit" comments while playing. There are recent releases of this game which are good, but not nearly as difficult and in depth as this version.

Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic - You play as a Jedi and use the Force to kill things. Best description I can think of

Ultima Series - Lots of indepth RPG in this game series. Very entertaing and it will keep you sucked in for a long time

Darklands - Another hit from Microprose. You play in 13th century Germany if I remember correctly and fight demons. When it came out it was the buggier then an ant hill, but it is solid now.

Betrayal at Krondor - Excellent game based off of the Fiest universe. It is a tad short, but enjoyable.
